title: Celery tasks guide (paraphrase)
text: Celery runs background tasks with a message broker such as RabbitMQ or Redis. By default a task message is acknowledged just before execution; with acks_late it is acknowledged after the task returns, so a task may run more than once if a worker crashes. Tasks should therefore be idempotent. Operating Celery requires running the broker and the worker processes.
